title: Nvidia PAIR makes it easy to create a household data center for running agentic AI tasks
summary: Nvidia PAIR makes it easy to create a household data center for running agentic AI tasks SiliconANGLE
body: Nvidia PAIR makes it easy to create a household data center for running agentic AI tasks SiliconANGLE
summaryZh: 英伟达推出的PAIR简化了普通用户构建家庭数据中心的过程，使其能够更方便地运行各种复杂的智能体AI任务，降低了个人和小型场景使用大模型代理的门槛。原始信息显示：Nvidia PAIR makes it easy to create a household data center for running agentic AI tasks siliconangle.com。该消息由siliconangle.com发布，主题为“Nvidia PAIR makes it easy to create a household data center for running agentic AI tasks”。其重要性主要体现在：英伟达推出PAIR简化了家庭数据中心的搭建，便于用户运行智能体AI任务，推动边缘AI基础设施普及。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
